title: Make required-service deployment exact and rollback-safe

ACG-09-005.action: Point command and healthcheck at one executable and verify imports before success.
ACG-09-005.gate: Container remains running/healthy with restart count stable at zero.

ACG-09-006.action: Add Agora interaction worker under Loop 5.
ACG-09-006.gate: Deployment contract fails when the worker is missing.

ACG-09-007.action: Include every BFF-image-owned persistent process, including Agora interaction worker.
ACG-09-007.gate: Deploy and rollback change/restore the same exact service set.

ACG-09-008.action: Check service existence, unique active container, running/health state, command and OCI revision.
ACG-09-008.gate: Fixture contracts and live dev verification reject missing, restarting, unhealthy or wrong-SHA services.

ACG-09-009.artifact: hosted acceptance based only on FE/BFF pair
ACG-09-009.canonical_owner: pair receipt plus backend required-component receipt
ACG-09-009.action: Block acceptance until the exact required-component gate passes while retaining FE/BFF pair identity.
ACG-09-009.gate: A broken required worker makes the candidate unaccepted.

functional_repair.reopened_reason: The prior writer could swallow receipt failures, dirty the managed deploy worktree, emit passed receipts for incomplete service sets, and exit past the rollback caller.
functional_repair.receipt_write_contract: git-external atomic replace; directory/write/serialization failures return non-zero to the deployment rollback caller
functional_repair.receipt_identity_contract: exact frontend and backend SHAs, deployment checkout HEAD, deployment environment/component, complete required_services set, per-service container/image/command identity, exact container-to-Compose OCI image ID, exact OCI revision when embedded, zero restart count, and explicit verification failure lists
functional_repair.hosted_acceptance_status: not rerun for repaired head; a real deployment must generate the runtime receipt
